question: Do immutable hand-size-payoff and exact-candidate Bloodfire complementarity evidence form a policy-sensitive, reachable and functionally separated Ashwarden package pair on the frozen root-550 structural-null whole-run rectangle?
retrospectiveScope: This is a declared retrospective, zero-new-row package-inventory audit. It does not re-estimate immutable #524/#525 hand-size complementarity or the exact-candidate Bloodfire causal panel. It uses their frozen activation definitions on one complete structural-null policy rectangle and can admit only Ash package support, not the rejected scalar substrate, a detector or product content.

ash-hand-size-payoff.activation: At least one final deck contains Phantom Blades and Preparation or Surge; Phantom Blades and a present producer are both played; phantomDamage is positive.

estimands.packageSupport: For each package, count root-550 structural-null active/inactive, final-pair reachable and consumer-reached policy identities.
estimands.functionalSeparation: Count hand-size-only, Bloodfire-only and cross-active policy identities on the same structural-null rectangle.
estimands.faults: Count policy rows with non-empty error or stall/error outcome.

gates.provenance: The decision uses only the unchanged 32/32 sensitivity, 16 reachability and eight within-aspect separation minima from the package-order held-out protocol. The cross-active value is descriptive and does not enter package admission.

decisionRules.success: Both Ash packages have at least 32 active and 32 inactive policy identities, at least 16 final-pair and consumer-reached identities, at least eight hand-size-only and eight Bloodfire-only identities, and zero policy faults.
decisionRules.futility: Any package sensitivity, reachability, functional-separation or fault gate fails.
decisionRules.inconclusive: Any immutable hash, complete rectangle, exact policy identity, ledger identity, numeric input or wall-time assertion fails before the deterministic decision.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Admit Ashwarden hand-size-payoff and Bloodfire as the two package-support directions for subsequent matched detector construction. This does not promote the rejected scalar substrate, universal order grammar, detector, product content or protected seeds.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Close the hand-size-plus-Bloodfire pair and continue to a materially different evidence-backed Ash structure inside issue #421; do not rescue it by policy-preference retuning.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Record no decision and run no simulator row until the immutable evidence fault is resolved.
